#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Frontier AI Models Compared — Intelligence, Speed & Cost
A1 Portrait Poster (594x841mm, 150 DPI)
Design Philosophy: Chromatic Data
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.font_manager as fm
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, Rectangle
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import os

# ─── Paths ───
FONT_DIR = "/usr/share/fonts/canvas-design"
OUTPUT_PATH = "/app/output/final_poster.png"

# ─── Register fonts ───
font_files = {
    'InstrumentSans-Bold': os.path.join(FONT_DIR, 'InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf'),
    'InstrumentSans-Regular': os.path.join(FONT_DIR, 'InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf'),
    'InstrumentSans-Italic': os.path.join(FONT_DIR, 'InstrumentSans-Italic.ttf'),
    'JetBrainsMono-Bold': os.path.join(FONT_DIR, 'JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf'),
    'JetBrainsMono-Regular': os.path.join(FONT_DIR, 'JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf'),
    'Jura-Light': os.path.join(FONT_DIR, 'Jura-Light.ttf'),
    'Jura-Medium': os.path.join(FONT_DIR, 'Jura-Medium.ttf'),
    'WorkSans-Bold': os.path.join(FONT_DIR, 'WorkSans-Bold.ttf'),
    'WorkSans-Regular': os.path.join(FONT_DIR, 'WorkSans-Regular.ttf'),
}
for name, path in font_files.items():
    fm.fontManager.addfont(path)

# ─── Color Palette ───
BG = '#0C1017'
BG_PANEL = '#0F141D'
DIVIDER = '#1A2030'
GRID = '#141B28'
TXT = '#E2E8F0'
TXT2 = '#8896A8'
TXT3 = '#4A5568'
BLUE = '#4DA8FF'
BLUE_DIM = '#1A3A5C'
BLUE_BG = '#0C1A2E'
TEAL = '#2DD4A8'
TEAL_DIM = '#0F3D33'
TEAL_BG = '#0A1F1A'
AMBER = '#F5A623'
AMBER_DIM = '#3D2E0A'
AMBER_BG = '#1A1508'
WHITE = '#FFFFFF'

# ─── Data ───
models = [
    {'name': 'Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview', 'short': 'Gemini 3.1 Pro', 'intel': 57, 'speed': 129, 'price': 4.50},
    {'name': 'GPT-5.4 (xhigh)', 'short': 'GPT-5.4', 'intel': 57, 'speed': 72, 'price': 5.60},
    {'name': 'Claude Opus 4.6 (max)', 'short': 'Opus 4.6', 'intel': 53, 'speed': 40, 'price': 10.00},
    {'name': 'Muse Spark', 'short': 'Muse Spark', 'intel': 52, 'speed': None, 'price': None},
    {'name': 'Claude Sonnet 4.6 (max)', 'short': 'Sonnet 4.6', 'intel': 52, 'speed': 48, 'price': 6.00},
    {'name': 'GLM-5.1', 'short': 'GLM-5.1', 'intel': 51, 'speed': 40, 'price': 2.10},
    {'name': 'Grok 4.20 0309 v2', 'short': 'Grok 4.20', 'intel': 49, 'speed': 162, 'price': 3.00},
    {'name': 'Gemini 3 Flash', 'short': 'Gemini 3 Flash', 'intel': 46, 'speed': 149, 'price': 1.10},
    {'name': 'DeepSeek V3.2', 'short': 'DeepSeek V3.2', 'intel': 42, 'speed': 31, 'price': 0.30},
    {'name': 'NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super', 'short': 'Nemotron 3', 'intel': 36, 'speed': 193, 'price': 0.40},
    {'name': 'gpt-oss-120B (high)', 'short': 'gpt-oss-120B', 'intel': 33, 'speed': 206, 'price': 0.30},
]
bubble_models = [m for m in models if m['speed'] is not None and m['price'] is not None]

# ─── Figure ───
DPI = 150
W_IN = 23.39
H_IN = 33.11

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(W_IN, H_IN), dpi=DPI, facecolor=BG)

# Layout: manual axes placement [left, bottom, width, height] in figure coords
ML = 0.075   # margin left
MR = 0.055   # margin right
CW = 1 - ML - MR  # content width

# Section positions (bottom, height) — stacked bottom to top
sections = {
    'method':  (0.012, 0.028),
    'trade':   (0.052, 0.250),
    'price':   (0.318, 0.160),
    'speed':   (0.494, 0.160),
    'intel':   (0.670, 0.175),
    'title':   (0.862, 0.128),
}

axes = {}
for name, (bot, ht) in sections.items():
    ax = fig.add_axes([ML, bot, CW, ht])
    ax.set_facecolor(BG)
    ax.set_xticks([])
    ax.set_yticks([])
    for sp in ax.spines.values():
        sp.set_visible(False)
    axes[name] = ax

# ── Helpers ──
def divider_line(ax, y_frac=1.0):
    """Draw a subtle horizontal divider near the top of an axes."""
    xlim = ax.get_xlim()
    ax.plot([xlim[0], xlim[1]], [y_frac, y_frac], color=DIVIDER,
            linewidth=0.6, transform=ax.transAxes, clip_on=False)

def section_label(ax, text, color, y=1.06):
    ax.text(0, y, text, fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=color,
            fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='bottom', ha='left',
            transform=ax.transAxes)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TITLE + HERO STATS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['title']
ax.set_xlim(0, 100)
ax.set_ylim(0, 100)

# Main title
ax.text(0, 95, 'FRONTIER AI MODELS COMPARED',
        fontsize=30, fontweight='bold', color=TXT,
        fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top', ha='left')

ax.text(0, 82, 'Intelligence, Speed & Cost',
        fontsize=19, color=TXT2,
        fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top', ha='left')

# Subtitle
ax.text(0, 71, 'Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.0  |  Top 10 Models  |  3 Dimensions  |  10 Benchmarks',
        fontsize=9, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top', ha='left')

# Divider
ax.plot([0, 100], [65, 65], color=DIVIDER, linewidth=1)

# ── Hero stat cards ──
card_y = 32
card_h = 26
card_w = 29
cards = [
    {'x': 2,   'val': '57',   'accent': BLUE,  'dim': BLUE_DIM,  'bg': BLUE_BG,
     'label1': 'TIED TOP INTELLIGENCE', 'label2': 'Gemini 3.1 Pro & GPT-5.4'},
    {'x': 35,  'val': '206',  'accent': TEAL,  'dim': TEAL_DIM,  'bg': TEAL_BG,
     'label1': 'FASTEST OUTPUT SPEED',   'label2': 'gpt-oss-120B  tok/s'},
    {'x': 68,  'val': '33x',  'accent': AMBER, 'dim': AMBER_DIM, 'bg': AMBER_BG,
     'label1': 'PRICE RANGE FACTOR',     'label2': '$0.30 to $10.00 per 1M tok'},
]

for c in cards:
    # Card background
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((c['x'], card_y - card_h/2), card_w, card_h,
                           boxstyle="round,pad=1", facecolor=c['bg'],
                           edgecolor=c['dim'], linewidth=1.0)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    # Accent bar at top
    ax.plot([c['x'] + 2, c['x'] + 9], [card_y + card_h/2 - 2.5]*2,
            color=c['accent'], linewidth=2.5, solid_capstyle='round')
    # Value
    ax.text(c['x'] + 2, card_y + 3, c['val'], fontsize=38, fontweight='bold',
            color=c['accent'], fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center')
    # Labels
    ax.text(c['x'] + 2, card_y - 7, c['label1'], fontsize=7,
            color=TXT2, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center')
    ax.text(c['x'] + 2, card_y - 11.5, c['label2'], fontsize=6.5,
            color=TXT3, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# INTELLIGENCE RANKINGS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['intel']
intel_models = sorted(models, key=lambda m: m['intel'], reverse=True)
n = len(intel_models)

ax.set_xlim(0, 65)
ax.set_ylim(-0.8, n + 1.2)

section_label(ax, 'INTELLIGENCE RANKINGS', BLUE)
ax.text(1, 1.06, 'AA Index v4.0', fontsize=7.5, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='bottom', ha='right',
        transform=ax.transAxes)

# Grid
for v in [10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60]:
    ax.axvline(x=v, color=GRID, linewidth=0.4, zorder=0)

bh = 0.62
for i, m in enumerate(intel_models):
    y = n - 1 - i
    sc = m['intel']
    alpha = 0.25 + 0.75 * (sc / 60)

    # Bar with rounded end effect (use barh + overlay)
    ax.barh(y, sc, height=bh, color=BLUE, alpha=alpha, zorder=2,
            edgecolor='none')

    # Glow for top 3
    if sc >= 52:
        ax.barh(y, sc, height=bh + 0.12, color=BLUE, alpha=0.07, zorder=1,
                edgecolor='none')

    # Score
    ax.text(sc + 0.7, y, str(sc), fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold',
            color=BLUE if sc >= 46 else TXT2,
            fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center', ha='left')

    # Model name (right-aligned to left margin)
    ax.text(-0.5, y, m['short'], fontsize=8.5, color=TXT,
            fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center', ha='right')

# Annotation
ax.text(64, -0.2, '24-pt gap top to bottom', fontsize=7,
        color=BLUE, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top', ha='right',
        style='italic')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# OUTPUT SPEED
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['speed']
speed_models = sorted([m for m in models if m['speed'] is not None],
                       key=lambda m: m['speed'], reverse=True)
n = len(speed_models)

ax.set_xlim(0, 240)
ax.set_ylim(-0.8, n + 1.2)

section_label(ax, 'OUTPUT SPEED', TEAL)
ax.text(1, 1.06, 'tokens / sec', fontsize=7.5, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='bottom', ha='right',
        transform=ax.transAxes)

for v in [50, 100, 150, 200]:
    ax.axvline(x=v, color=GRID, linewidth=0.4, zorder=0)

for i, m in enumerate(speed_models):
    y = n - 1 - i
    spd = m['speed']
    alpha = 0.25 + 0.75 * (spd / 220)

    ax.barh(y, spd, height=bh, color=TEAL, alpha=alpha, zorder=2,
            edgecolor='none')

    # Speed label
    ax.text(spd + 3, y, str(spd), fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold',
            color=TEAL if spd >= 100 else TXT2,
            fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center', ha='left')

    # Model name
    ax.text(-2, y, m['short'], fontsize=8.5, color=TXT,
            fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center', ha='right')

    # IQ tag
    ax.text(spd + 18, y, f'IQ {m["intel"]}', fontsize=5.5, color=TXT3,
            fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center', ha='left')

# Key insight
ax.text(238, -0.2, 'Fastest model ranks last in intelligence', fontsize=7,

for v in [2, 4, 6, 8, 10]:

for i, m in enumerate(price_models):

    ax.text(pr + 0.15, y, label, fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold',

    ax.text(-0.3, y, m['short'], fontsize=8.5, color=TXT,
            fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center', ha='right')

# Insight
ax.text(11.8, -0.2, '33x cost spread  |  Premium IQ != premium speed', fontsize=7,
        color=AMBER, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top', ha='right',
        style='italic')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

ax = axes['trade']

ix_lo, ix_hi = 28, 62

for sv in [50, 100, 150, 200]:

# Axis labels
ax.set_xlabel('INTELLIGENCE SCORE  >', fontsize=9, color=BLUE,

ax.set_ylabel('OUTPUT SPEED (tokens/sec)  >', fontsize=9, color=TEAL,

ax.set_yticks([50, 100, 150, 200])

ax.tick_params(axis='both', length=2, color=TXT3, width=0.5)
for sp in ax.spines.values():

    sp.set_linewidth(0.5)

ax.text(0.5, 1.10, 'THE INTELLIGENCE-SPEED-COST TRADE-OFF',

ax.text(0.5, 1.055, 'Bubble size = Price per 1M tokens  |  Larger bubble = Higher cost',

# ── Insight callouts below chart ──
# These are drawn as colored accent blocks in the lower-left margin
insights = [
    (BLUE,  'BEST OVERALL',  'Gemini 3.1 Pro & GPT-5.4 tied at 57'),

ax.set_xlim(0, 100)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Frontier AI Models Compared — Intelligence, Speed & Cost
A1 Portrait Poster (594x841mm, 150 DPI)
Design Philosophy: Chromatic Data
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.font_manager as fm
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, Rectangle
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import os

# ─── Paths ───
FONT_DIR = "/usr/share/fonts/canvas-design"
OUTPUT_PATH = "/app/output/final_poster.png"

# ─── Register fonts ───
font_files = {
    'InstrumentSans-Bold': os.path.join(FONT_DIR, 'InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf'),
    'InstrumentSans-Regular': os.path.join(FONT_DIR, 'InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf'),
    'InstrumentSans-Italic': os.path.join(FONT_DIR, 'InstrumentSans-Italic.ttf'),
    'JetBrainsMono-Bold': os.path.join(FONT_DIR, 'JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf'),
    'JetBrainsMono-Regular': os.path.join(FONT_DIR, 'JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf'),
    'Jura-Light': os.path.join(FONT_DIR, 'Jura-Light.ttf'),
    'Jura-Medium': os.path.join(FONT_DIR, 'Jura-Medium.ttf'),
    'WorkSans-Bold': os.path.join(FONT_DIR, 'WorkSans-Bold.ttf'),
    'WorkSans-Regular': os.path.join(FONT_DIR, 'WorkSans-Regular.ttf'),
}
for name, path in font_files.items():
    fm.fontManager.addfont(path)

# ─── Color Palette ───
BG = '#0C1017'
BG_PANEL = '#0F141D'
DIVIDER = '#1A2030'
GRID = '#141B28'
TXT = '#E2E8F0'
TXT2 = '#8896A8'
TXT3 = '#4A5568'
BLUE = '#4DA8FF'
BLUE_DIM = '#1A3A5C'
BLUE_BG = '#0C1A2E'
TEAL = '#2DD4A8'
TEAL_DIM = '#0F3D33'
TEAL_BG = '#0A1F1A'
AMBER = '#F5A623'
AMBER_DIM = '#3D2E0A'
AMBER_BG = '#1A1508'
WHITE = '#FFFFFF'

# ─── Data ───
models = [
    {'name': 'Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview', 'short': 'Gemini 3.1 Pro', 'intel': 57, 'speed': 129, 'price': 4.50},
    {'name': 'GPT-5.4 (xhigh)', 'short': 'GPT-5.4', 'intel': 57, 'speed': 72, 'price': 5.60},
    {'name': 'Claude Opus 4.6 (max)', 'short': 'Opus 4.6', 'intel': 53, 'speed': 40, 'price': 10.00},
    {'name': 'Muse Spark', 'short': 'Muse Spark', 'intel': 52, 'speed': None, 'price': None},
    {'name': 'Claude Sonnet 4.6 (max)', 'short': 'Sonnet 4.6', 'intel': 52, 'speed': 48, 'price': 6.00},
    {'name': 'GLM-5.1', 'short': 'GLM-5.1', 'intel': 51, 'speed': 40, 'price': 2.10},
    {'name': 'Grok 4.20 0309 v2', 'short': 'Grok 4.20', 'intel': 49, 'speed': 162, 'price': 3.00},
    {'name': 'Gemini 3 Flash', 'short': 'Gemini 3 Flash', 'intel': 46, 'speed': 149, 'price': 1.10},
    {'name': 'DeepSeek V3.2', 'short': 'DeepSeek V3.2', 'intel': 42, 'speed': 31, 'price': 0.30},
    {'name': 'NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super', 'short': 'Nemotron 3', 'intel': 36, 'speed': 193, 'price': 0.40},
    {'name': 'gpt-oss-120B (high)', 'short': 'gpt-oss-120B', 'intel': 33, 'speed': 206, 'price': 0.30},
]
bubble_models = [m for m in models if m['speed'] is not None and m['price'] is not None]

# ─── Figure ───
DPI = 150
W_IN = 23.39
H_IN = 33.11

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(W_IN, H_IN), dpi=DPI, facecolor=BG)

# Layout: manual axes placement [left, bottom, width, height] in figure coords
ML = 0.075   # margin left
MR = 0.055   # margin right
CW = 1 - ML - MR  # content width

# Section positions (bottom, height) — stacked bottom to top
sections = {
    'method':  (0.012, 0.028),
    'trade':   (0.052, 0.250),
    'price':   (0.318, 0.160),
    'speed':   (0.494, 0.160),
    'intel':   (0.670, 0.175),
    'title':   (0.862, 0.128),
}

axes = {}
for name, (bot, ht) in sections.items():
    ax = fig.add_axes([ML, bot, CW, ht])
    ax.set_facecolor(BG)
    ax.set_xticks([])
    ax.set_yticks([])
    for sp in ax.spines.values():
        sp.set_visible(False)
    axes[name] = ax

# ── Helpers ──
def divider_line(ax, y_frac=1.0):
    """Draw a subtle horizontal divider near the top of an axes."""
    xlim = ax.get_xlim()
    ax.plot([xlim[0], xlim[1]], [y_frac, y_frac], color=DIVIDER,
            linewidth=0.6, transform=ax.transAxes, clip_on=False)

def section_label(ax, text, color, y=1.06):
    ax.text(0, y, text, fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=color,
            fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='bottom', ha='left',
            transform=ax.transAxes)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TITLE + HERO STATS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['title']
ax.set_xlim(0, 100)
ax.set_ylim(0, 100)

# Main title
ax.text(0, 95, 'FRONTIER AI MODELS COMPARED',
        fontsize=30, fontweight='bold', color=TXT,
        fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top', ha='left')

ax.text(0, 82, 'Intelligence, Speed & Cost',
        fontsize=19, color=TXT2,
        fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top', ha='left')

# Subtitle
ax.text(0, 71, 'Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.0  |  Top 10 Models  |  3 Dimensions  |  10 Benchmarks',
        fontsize=9, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top', ha='left')

# Divider
ax.plot([0, 100], [65, 65], color=DIVIDER, linewidth=1)

# ── Hero stat cards ──
card_y = 32
card_h = 26
card_w = 29
cards = [
    {'x': 2,   'val': '57',   'accent': BLUE,  'dim': BLUE_DIM,  'bg': BLUE_BG,
     'label1': 'TIED TOP INTELLIGENCE', 'label2': 'Gemini 3.1 Pro & GPT-5.4'},
    {'x': 35,  'val': '206',  'accent': TEAL,  'dim': TEAL_DIM,  'bg': TEAL_BG,
     'label1': 'FASTEST OUTPUT SPEED',   'label2': 'gpt-oss-120B  tok/s'},
    {'x': 68,  'val': '33x',  'accent': AMBER, 'dim': AMBER_DIM, 'bg': AMBER_BG,
     'label1': 'PRICE RANGE FACTOR',     'label2': '$0.30 to $10.00 per 1M tok'},
]

for c in cards:
    # Card background
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((c['x'], card_y - card_h/2), card_w, card_h,
                           boxstyle="round,pad=1", facecolor=c['bg'],
                           edgecolor=c['dim'], linewidth=1.0)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    # Accent bar at top
    ax.plot([c['x'] + 2, c['x'] + 9], [card_y + card_h/2 - 2.5]*2,
            color=c['accent'], linewidth=2.5, solid_capstyle='round')
    # Value
    ax.text(c['x'] + 2, card_y + 3, c['val'], fontsize=38, fontweight='bold',
            color=c['accent'], fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center')
    # Labels
    ax.text(c['x'] + 2, card_y - 7, c['label1'], fontsize=7,
            color=TXT2, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center')
    ax.text(c['x'] + 2, card_y - 11.5, c['label2'], fontsize=6.5,
            color=TXT3, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# INTELLIGENCE RANKINGS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['intel']
intel_models = sorted(models, key=lambda m: m['intel'], reverse=True)
n = len(intel_models)

ax.set_xlim(0, 65)
ax.set_ylim(-0.8, n + 1.2)

section_label(ax, 'INTELLIGENCE RANKINGS', BLUE)
ax.text(1, 1.06, 'AA Index v4.0', fontsize=7.5, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='bottom', ha='right',
        transform=ax.transAxes)

# Grid
for v in [10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60]:
    ax.axvline(x=v, color=GRID, linewidth=0.4, zorder=0)

bh = 0.62
for i, m in enumerate(intel_models):
    y = n - 1 - i
    sc = m['intel']
    alpha = 0.25 + 0.75 * (sc / 60)

    # Bar with rounded end effect (use barh + overlay)
    ax.barh(y, sc, height=bh, color=BLUE, alpha=alpha, zorder=2,
            edgecolor='none')

    # Glow for top 3
    if sc >= 52:
        ax.barh(y, sc, height=bh + 0.12, color=BLUE, alpha=0.07, zorder=1,
                edgecolor='none')

    # Score
    ax.text(sc + 0.7, y, str(sc), fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold',
            color=BLUE if sc >= 46 else TXT2,
            fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center', ha='left')

    # Model name (right-aligned to left margin)
    ax.text(-0.5, y, m['short'], fontsize=8.5, color=TXT,
            fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center', ha='right')

# Annotation
ax.text(64, -0.2, '24-pt gap top to bottom', fontsize=7,
        color=BLUE, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top', ha='right',
        style='italic')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# OUTPUT SPEED
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['speed']
speed_models = sorted([m for m in models if m['speed'] is not None],
                       key=lambda m: m['speed'], reverse=True)
n = len(speed_models)

ax.set_xlim(0, 240)
ax.set_ylim(-0.8, n + 1.2)

section_label(ax, 'OUTPUT SPEED', TEAL)
ax.text(1, 1.06, 'tokens / sec', fontsize=7.5, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='bottom', ha='right',
        transform=ax.transAxes)

for v in [50, 100, 150, 200]:
    ax.axvline(x=v, color=GRID, linewidth=0.4, zorder=0)

for i, m in enumerate(speed_models):
    y = n - 1 - i
    spd = m['speed']
    alpha = 0.25 + 0.75 * (spd / 220)

    ax.barh(y, spd, height=bh, color=TEAL, alpha=alpha, zorder=2,
            edgecolor='none')

    # Speed label
    ax.text(spd + 3, y, str(spd), fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold',
            color=TEAL if spd >= 100 else TXT2,
            fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center', ha='left')

    # Model name
    ax.text(-2, y, m['short'], fontsize=8.5, color=TXT,
            fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center', ha='right')

    # IQ tag
    ax.text(spd + 18, y, f'IQ {m["intel"]}', fontsize=5.5, color=TXT3,
            fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center', ha='left')

# Key insight
ax.text(238, -0.2, 'Fastest model ranks last in intelligence', fontsize=7,
        color=TEAL, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top', ha='right',
        style='italic')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PRICING LANDSCAPE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['price']
price_models = sorted([m for m in models if m['price'] is not None],
                       key=lambda m: m['price'])
n = len(price_models)

ax.set_xlim(0, 12)
ax.set_ylim(-0.8, n + 1.2)

section_label(ax, 'PRICING LANDSCAPE', AMBER)
ax.text(1, 1.06, 'USD / 1M tokens', fontsize=7.5, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='bottom', ha='right',
        transform=ax.transAxes)

for v in [2, 4, 6, 8, 10]:
    ax.axvline(x=v, color=GRID, linewidth=0.4, zorder=0)

for i, m in enumerate(price_models):
    y = n - 1 - i
    pr = m['price']
    alpha = 0.25 + 0.75 * (pr / 10)

    ax.barh(y, pr, height=bh, color=AMBER, alpha=alpha, zorder=2,
            edgecolor='none')

    # Price label
    label = f'${pr:.2f}' if pr < 1 else f'${pr:.1f}'
    ax.text(pr + 0.15, y, label, fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold',
            color=AMBER if pr >= 3 else TXT2,
            fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center', ha='left')

    # Model name
    ax.text(-0.3, y, m['short'], fontsize=8.5, color=TXT,
            fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center', ha='right')

# Insight
ax.text(11.8, -0.2, '33x cost spread  |  Premium IQ != premium speed', fontsize=7,
        color=AMBER, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top', ha='right',
        style='italic')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TRADE-OFF BUBBLE CHART (HERO)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['trade']

ix_lo, ix_hi = 28, 62
sy_lo, sy_hi = 10, 230

ax.set_xlim(ix_lo, ix_hi)
ax.set_ylim(sy_lo, sy_hi)

# Grid
for iv in range(30, 65, 5):
    ax.axvline(x=iv, color=GRID, linewidth=0.4, zorder=0)
for sv in [50, 100, 150, 200]:
    ax.axhline(y=sv, color=GRID, linewidth=0.4, zorder=0)

# Axis labels
ax.set_xlabel('INTELLIGENCE SCORE  >', fontsize=9, color=BLUE,
              fontfamily='Instrument Sans', labelpad=10)
ax.set_ylabel('OUTPUT SPEED (tokens/sec)  >', fontsize=9, color=TEAL,
              fontfamily='Instrument Sans', labelpad=10)

ax.set_xticks(range(30, 65, 5))
ax.set_xticklabels([str(x) for x in range(30, 65, 5)],
                    fontsize=7, color=TXT3, fontfamily='JetBrains Mono')
ax.set_yticks([50, 100, 150, 200])
ax.set_yticklabels(['50', '100', '150', '200'],
                    fontsize=7, color=TXT3, fontfamily='JetBrains Mono')
ax.tick_params(axis='both', length=2, color=TXT3, width=0.5)
for sp in ax.spines.values():
    sp.set_color(DIVIDER)
    sp.set_linewidth(0.5)

# Section header (above plot area)
ax.text(0.5, 1.10, 'THE INTELLIGENCE-SPEED-COST TRADE-OFF',
        fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', color=TXT,
        fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='bottom', ha='center',
        transform=ax.transAxes)
ax.text(0.5, 1.055, 'Bubble size = Price per 1M tokens  |  Larger bubble = Higher cost',
        fontsize=7.5, color=TXT3, fontfamily='Instrument Sans',
        va='bottom', ha='center', transform=ax.transAxes)

# ── Draw diagonal "ideal" reference ──
ax.plot([ix_lo, ix_hi], [sy_hi, sy_hi * 0.6], color=DIVIDER,
        linewidth=0.8, linestyle='--', zorder=0, alpha=0.5)

# ── Quadrant labels ──
ax.text(60, 220, 'HIGH IQ + HIGH SPEED', fontsize=6, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', ha='right', va='top', alpha=0.5)
ax.text(30, 18, 'LOW IQ + LOW SPEED', fontsize=6, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', ha='left', va='bottom', alpha=0.5)

# ── Bubble sizes ──
prices = [m['price'] for m in bubble_models]
pmin, pmax = min(prices), max(prices)

def price_to_size(p):
    t = (p - pmin) / (pmax - pmin) if pmax > pmin else 0.5
    return 60 + t * 1800

# ── Plot bubbles ──
for m in bubble_models:

    elif m['price'] <= 1.0:

    else:
        col, ecol = TEAL, '#6EEECF'

    # Outer glow
    ax.scatter(x, y, s=s * 3, color=col, alpha=0.05, edgecolors='none', zorder=1)
    ax.scatter(x, y, s=s * 1.8, color=col, alpha=0.10, edgecolors='none', zorder=1)
    # Main bubble
    ax.scatter(x, y, s=s, color=col, alpha=0.50, edgecolors=ecol,
               linewidth=1.0, zorder=3)

# ── Labels with smart offsets ──
label_offsets = {

    'GPT-5.4':        (2.5, -14),
    'Opus 4.6':       (-3.5, -10),

                fontsize=7, fontweight='bold', color=TXT,
                fontfamily='Instrument Sans',
                ha='center', va='center',
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color=TXT3, lw=0.4,
                                connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.1'),
                zorder=5)

    # Price inside large bubbles
    if s > 350:
        lbl = f'${m["price"]:.2f}' if m['price'] < 1 else f'${m["price"]:.1f}'
        ax.text(x, y, lbl, fontsize=5.5, color=WHITE,
                fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', ha='center', va='center',
                zorder=6, alpha=0.85)

# ── Insight callouts below chart ──
# These are drawn as colored accent blocks in the lower-left margin
insights = [
    (BLUE,  'BEST OVERALL',  'Gemini 3.1 Pro & GPT-5.4 tied at 57'),
    (TEAL,  'BALANCED PICK',  'Gemini 3 Flash  |  IQ 46  |  149 tok/s  |  $1.10'),
    (AMBER, 'BEST VALUE',     'gpt-oss-120B  |  fastest + cheapest  |  IQ 33'),
]

for idx, (col, title, desc) in enumerate(insights):
    iy = -6 - idx * 6
    ax.text(ix_lo + 0.5, iy, title, fontsize=7, fontweight='bold',
            color=col, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center')
    ax.text(ix_lo + 16, iy, desc, fontsize=6.5, color=TXT2,
            fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center')
    # Small accent dot
    ax.plot(ix_lo + 0.1, iy, 'o', color=col, markersize=3, zorder=5)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# METHODOLOGY
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['method']
ax.set_xlim(0, 100)
ax.set_ylim(0, 100)

ax.plot([0, 100], [88, 88], color=DIVIDER, linewidth=0.6)

ax.text(0, 72, 'ABOUT THE INDEX', fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold',
        color=TXT3, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center')

ax.text(0, 40,
        'The Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.0 aggregates performance across 10 independent evaluations: '
        'GDPval-AA, t2-Bench Telecom, Terminal-Bench Hard, SciCode, AA-LCR, AA-Omniscience, IFBench, '
        "Humanity's Last Exam, GPQA Diamond, and CritPt. "
        'All measurements conducted independently under standardized conditions.',
        fontsize=6, color=TXT3, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center',
        wrap=True)

ax.text(100, 15, 'artificialanalysis.ai', fontsize=6.5, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center', ha='right', alpha=0.6)
ax.text(100, 3, 'Data as of Index v4.0', fontsize=5.5, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center', ha='right', alpha=0.4)

# ─── Save ───
plt.savefig(OUTPUT_PATH, dpi=DPI, facecolor=BG, edgecolor='none',
            pad_inches=0.2)
plt.close()

print(f"Saved: {OUTPUT_PATH}")
img = Image.open(OUTPUT_PATH)
print(f"Size: {img.size[0]}x{img.size[1]} px")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Frontier AI Models Compared — Intelligence, Speed & Cost
A1 Portrait Poster (594x841mm, 150 DPI) — REFINED
Design Philosophy: Chromatic Data
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.font_manager as fm
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, Rectangle
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import os

FONT_DIR = "/usr/share/fonts/canvas-design"
OUTPUT_PATH = "/app/output/final_poster.png"

# Register fonts
for fn in ['InstrumentSans-Bold', 'InstrumentSans-Regular', 'InstrumentSans-Italic',
           'JetBrainsMono-Bold', 'JetBrainsMono-Regular',
           'Jura-Light', 'Jura-Medium', 'WorkSans-Bold', 'WorkSans-Regular']:
    fm.fontManager.addfont(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, f'{fn}.ttf'))

# ─── Palette ───
BG      = '#0C1017'
PANEL   = '#0F141D'
GRID    = '#131B27'
DIV     = '#1A2030'
TXT     = '#E2E8F0'
TXT2    = '#8896A8'
TXT3    = '#4A5568'
BLUE    = '#4DA8FF'
BLUE_D  = '#1A3A5C'
BLUE_BG = '#0C1A2E'
TEAL    = '#2DD4A8'
TEAL_D  = '#0F3D33'
TEAL_BG = '#0A1F1A'
AMBER   = '#F5A623'
AMBER_D = '#3D2E0A'
AMBER_BG= '#1A1508'
WHITE   = '#FFFFFF'

# ─── Data ───
models = [
    {'name': 'Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview', 'short': 'Gemini 3.1 Pro',  'intel': 57, 'speed': 129, 'price': 4.50},
    {'name': 'GPT-5.4 (xhigh)',        'short': 'GPT-5.4',         'intel': 57, 'speed': 72,  'price': 5.60},
    {'name': 'Claude Opus 4.6 (max)',   'short': 'Opus 4.6',       'intel': 53, 'speed': 40,  'price': 10.00},
    {'name': 'Muse Spark',              'short': 'Muse Spark',      'intel': 52, 'speed': None, 'price': None},
    {'name': 'Claude Sonnet 4.6 (max)', 'short': 'Sonnet 4.6',     'intel': 52, 'speed': 48,  'price': 6.00},
    {'name': 'GLM-5.1',                'short': 'GLM-5.1',         'intel': 51, 'speed': 40,  'price': 2.10},
    {'name': 'Grok 4.20 0309 v2',      'short': 'Grok 4.20',      'intel': 49, 'speed': 162, 'price': 3.00},
    {'name': 'Gemini 3 Flash',          'short': 'Gemini 3 Flash', 'intel': 46, 'speed': 149, 'price': 1.10},
    {'name': 'DeepSeek V3.2',          'short': 'DeepSeek V3.2',   'intel': 42, 'speed': 31,  'price': 0.30},
    {'name': 'NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super', 'short': 'Nemotron 3',     'intel': 36, 'speed': 193, 'price': 0.40},
    {'name': 'gpt-oss-120B (high)',     'short': 'gpt-oss-120B',   'intel': 33, 'speed': 206, 'price': 0.30},
]
bubble_m = [m for m in models if m['speed'] is not None and m['price'] is not None]

# ─── Figure ───
DPI = 150
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(23.39, 33.11), dpi=DPI, facecolor=BG)

ML, MR = 0.075, 0.055
CW = 1 - ML - MR

# Sections: (bottom, height) — bottom to top
sec = {
    'method': (0.010, 0.030),
    'trade':  (0.050, 0.260),
    'price':  (0.325, 0.158),
    'speed':  (0.498, 0.158),
    'intel':  (0.671, 0.170),
    'title':  (0.858, 0.132),
}

axes = {}
for name, (bot, ht) in sec.items():
    ax = fig.add_axes([ML, bot, CW, ht])
    ax.set_facecolor(BG)
    ax.set_xticks([]); ax.set_yticks([])
    for sp in ax.spines.values(): sp.set_visible(False)
    axes[name] = ax

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TITLE + HERO STATS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['title']
ax.set_xlim(0, 100); ax.set_ylim(0, 100)

# Title
ax.text(1, 95, 'FRONTIER AI MODELS COMPARED',
        fontsize=30, fontweight='bold', color=TXT,
        fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top')
ax.text(1, 82, 'Intelligence, Speed & Cost',
        fontsize=19, color=TXT2, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top')
ax.text(1, 71, 'Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.0  |  10 Models  |  3 Dimensions  |  10 Benchmarks',
        fontsize=9, color=TXT3, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top')

# Divider
ax.plot([0, 100], [65, 65], color=DIV, linewidth=1)

# Hero stat cards
cy, ch, cw = 32, 27, 29.5
cards = [
    {'x': 1.5, 'val': '57',  'acc': BLUE,  'dim': BLUE_D,  'bg': BLUE_BG,
     'l1': 'TIED TOP INTELLIGENCE', 'l2': 'Gemini 3.1 Pro & GPT-5.4'},
    {'x': 34,  'val': '206', 'acc': TEAL,  'dim': TEAL_D,  'bg': TEAL_BG,
     'l1': 'FASTEST OUTPUT SPEED',   'l2': 'gpt-oss-120B  |  tokens/sec'},
    {'x': 66.5,'val': '33x', 'acc': AMBER, 'dim': AMBER_D, 'bg': AMBER_BG,
     'l1': 'PRICE RANGE FACTOR',     'l2': '$0.30 to $10.00 per 1M tokens'},
]
for c in cards:
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((c['x'], cy - ch/2), cw, ch,
                           boxstyle="round,pad=1.0", facecolor=c['bg'],
                           edgecolor=c['dim'], linewidth=1.0)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    ax.plot([c['x']+2, c['x']+9], [cy + ch/2 - 2]*2,
            color=c['acc'], linewidth=2.5, solid_capstyle='round')
    ax.text(c['x']+2, cy+4, c['val'], fontsize=38, fontweight='bold',
            color=c['acc'], fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center')
    ax.text(c['x']+2, cy-6.5, c['l1'], fontsize=7,
            color=TXT2, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center')
    ax.text(c['x']+2, cy-11, c['l2'], fontsize=6.5,
            color=TXT3, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# INTELLIGENCE RANKINGS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['intel']
im = sorted(models, key=lambda m: m['intel'], reverse=True)
n = len(im)
ax.set_xlim(0, 65); ax.set_ylim(-1.0, n + 1.5)

# Header
ax.text(0.0, 1.08, 'INTELLIGENCE RANKINGS', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold',
        color=BLUE, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='bottom',
        transform=ax.transAxes)
ax.text(1.0, 1.08, 'AA Index v4.0', fontsize=7.5, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='bottom', ha='right',
        transform=ax.transAxes)
# Small accent dot
ax.plot(0.0, 1.10, 'o', color=BLUE, markersize=4,
        transform=ax.transAxes, clip_on=False)

bh = 0.62
for v in [10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60]:
    ax.axvline(x=v, color=GRID, linewidth=0.4, zorder=0)

for i, m in enumerate(im):
    y = n - 1 - i
    sc = m['intel']
    a = 0.22 + 0.78 * (sc / 60)
    ax.barh(y, sc, height=bh, color=BLUE, alpha=a, zorder=2, edgecolor='none')
    if sc >= 53:
        ax.barh(y, sc, height=bh+0.12, color=BLUE, alpha=0.06, zorder=1, edgecolor='none')
    ax.text(sc + 0.7, y, str(sc), fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold',
            color=BLUE if sc >= 46 else TXT2, fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center')
    ax.text(-0.5, y, m['short'], fontsize=8.5, color=TXT,
            fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center', ha='right')

ax.text(64, -0.4, '24-pt gap from top to bottom', fontsize=7,
        color=BLUE, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top', ha='right', style='italic')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# OUTPUT SPEED
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['speed']
sm = sorted([m for m in models if m['speed'] is not None], key=lambda m: m['speed'], reverse=True)
n = len(sm)
ax.set_xlim(0, 240); ax.set_ylim(-1.0, n + 1.5)

ax.text(0.0, 1.08, 'OUTPUT SPEED', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold',
        color=TEAL, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='bottom',
        transform=ax.transAxes)
ax.text(1.0, 1.08, 'tokens / sec', fontsize=7.5, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='bottom', ha='right',
        transform=ax.transAxes)
ax.plot(0.0, 1.10, 'o', color=TEAL, markersize=4,
        transform=ax.transAxes, clip_on=False)

for v in [50, 100, 150, 200]:
    ax.axvline(x=v, color=GRID, linewidth=0.4, zorder=0)

for i, m in enumerate(sm):
    y = n - 1 - i
    spd = m['speed']
    a = 0.22 + 0.78 * (spd / 220)

def p2s(p):
    t = (p - pmin) / (pmax - pmin) if pmax > pmin else 0.5
    return 60 + t * 1900

offsets = {
    'Gemini 3.1 Pro': ( 2.0,  14),
    'GPT-5.4':        ( 3.0, -15),
    'Opus 4.6':       (-3.5, -11),

}

for m in bubble_m:

    if m['price'] >= 5.0:
        col, ecol = BLUE, '#7CC4FF'
    elif m['price'] <= 1.0:
        col, ecol = AMBER, '#FFCA5C'
    else:
        col, ecol = TEAL, '#6EEECF'

    # Glow layers
    ax.scatter(x, y, s=s*3.2, color=col, alpha=0.04, edgecolors='none', zorder=1)
    ax.scatter(x, y, s=s*1.8, color=col, alpha=0.09, edgecolors='none', zorder=1)
    # Main
    ax.scatter(x, y, s=s, color=col, alpha=0.50, edgecolors=ecol,
               linewidth=1.0, zorder=3)

for m in bubble_m:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Frontier AI Models Compared — Intelligence, Speed & Cost
A1 Portrait Poster (594x841mm, 150 DPI) — REFINED
Design Philosophy: Chromatic Data
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.font_manager as fm
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, Rectangle
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import os

FONT_DIR = "/usr/share/fonts/canvas-design"
OUTPUT_PATH = "/app/output/final_poster.png"

# Register fonts
for fn in ['InstrumentSans-Bold', 'InstrumentSans-Regular', 'InstrumentSans-Italic',
           'JetBrainsMono-Bold', 'JetBrainsMono-Regular',
           'Jura-Light', 'Jura-Medium', 'WorkSans-Bold', 'WorkSans-Regular']:
    fm.fontManager.addfont(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, f'{fn}.ttf'))

# ─── Palette ───
BG      = '#0C1017'
PANEL   = '#0F141D'
GRID    = '#131B27'
DIV     = '#1A2030'
TXT     = '#E2E8F0'
TXT2    = '#8896A8'
TXT3    = '#4A5568'
BLUE    = '#4DA8FF'
BLUE_D  = '#1A3A5C'
BLUE_BG = '#0C1A2E'
TEAL    = '#2DD4A8'
TEAL_D  = '#0F3D33'
TEAL_BG = '#0A1F1A'
AMBER   = '#F5A623'
AMBER_D = '#3D2E0A'
AMBER_BG= '#1A1508'
WHITE   = '#FFFFFF'

# ─── Data ───
models = [
    {'name': 'Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview', 'short': 'Gemini 3.1 Pro',  'intel': 57, 'speed': 129, 'price': 4.50},
    {'name': 'GPT-5.4 (xhigh)',        'short': 'GPT-5.4',         'intel': 57, 'speed': 72,  'price': 5.60},
    {'name': 'Claude Opus 4.6 (max)',   'short': 'Opus 4.6',       'intel': 53, 'speed': 40,  'price': 10.00},
    {'name': 'Muse Spark',              'short': 'Muse Spark',      'intel': 52, 'speed': None, 'price': None},
    {'name': 'Claude Sonnet 4.6 (max)', 'short': 'Sonnet 4.6',     'intel': 52, 'speed': 48,  'price': 6.00},
    {'name': 'GLM-5.1',                'short': 'GLM-5.1',         'intel': 51, 'speed': 40,  'price': 2.10},
    {'name': 'Grok 4.20 0309 v2',      'short': 'Grok 4.20',      'intel': 49, 'speed': 162, 'price': 3.00},
    {'name': 'Gemini 3 Flash',          'short': 'Gemini 3 Flash', 'intel': 46, 'speed': 149, 'price': 1.10},
    {'name': 'DeepSeek V3.2',          'short': 'DeepSeek V3.2',   'intel': 42, 'speed': 31,  'price': 0.30},
    {'name': 'NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super', 'short': 'Nemotron 3',     'intel': 36, 'speed': 193, 'price': 0.40},
    {'name': 'gpt-oss-120B (high)',     'short': 'gpt-oss-120B',   'intel': 33, 'speed': 206, 'price': 0.30},
]
bubble_m = [m for m in models if m['speed'] is not None and m['price'] is not None]

# ─── Figure ───
DPI = 150
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(23.39, 33.11), dpi=DPI, facecolor=BG)

ML, MR = 0.075, 0.055
CW = 1 - ML - MR

# Sections: (bottom, height) — bottom to top
sec = {
    'method': (0.010, 0.030),
    'trade':  (0.050, 0.260),
    'price':  (0.325, 0.158),
    'speed':  (0.498, 0.158),
    'intel':  (0.671, 0.170),
    'title':  (0.858, 0.132),
}

axes = {}
for name, (bot, ht) in sec.items():
    ax = fig.add_axes([ML, bot, CW, ht])
    ax.set_facecolor(BG)
    ax.set_xticks([]); ax.set_yticks([])
    for sp in ax.spines.values(): sp.set_visible(False)
    axes[name] = ax

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TITLE + HERO STATS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['title']
ax.set_xlim(0, 100); ax.set_ylim(0, 100)

# Title
ax.text(1, 95, 'FRONTIER AI MODELS COMPARED',
        fontsize=30, fontweight='bold', color=TXT,
        fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top')
ax.text(1, 82, 'Intelligence, Speed & Cost',
        fontsize=19, color=TXT2, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top')
ax.text(1, 71, 'Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.0  |  10 Models  |  3 Dimensions  |  10 Benchmarks',
        fontsize=9, color=TXT3, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top')

# Divider
ax.plot([0, 100], [65, 65], color=DIV, linewidth=1)

# Hero stat cards

    {'x': 1.5, 'val': '57',  'acc': BLUE,  'dim': BLUE_D,  'bg': BLUE_BG,

    {'x': 34,  'val': '206', 'acc': TEAL,  'dim': TEAL_D,  'bg': TEAL_BG,
     'l1': 'FASTEST OUTPUT SPEED',   'l2': 'gpt-oss-120B  |  tokens/sec'},
    {'x': 66.5,'val': '33x', 'acc': AMBER, 'dim': AMBER_D, 'bg': AMBER_BG,
     'l1': 'PRICE RANGE FACTOR',     'l2': '$0.30 to $10.00 per 1M tokens'},
]
for c in cards:
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((c['x'], cy - ch/2), cw, ch,
                           boxstyle="round,pad=1.0", facecolor=c['bg'],
                           edgecolor=c['dim'], linewidth=1.0)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    ax.plot([c['x']+2, c['x']+9], [cy + ch/2 - 2]*2,
            color=c['acc'], linewidth=2.5, solid_capstyle='round')
    ax.text(c['x']+2, cy+4, c['val'], fontsize=38, fontweight='bold',
            color=c['acc'], fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center')

            color=TXT2, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center')
    ax.text(c['x']+2, cy-11, c['l2'], fontsize=6.5,
            color=TXT3, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# INTELLIGENCE RANKINGS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['intel']
im = sorted(models, key=lambda m: m['intel'], reverse=True)
n = len(im)
ax.set_xlim(0, 65); ax.set_ylim(-1.0, n + 1.5)

# Header
ax.text(0.0, 1.08, 'INTELLIGENCE RANKINGS', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold',
        color=BLUE, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='bottom',
        transform=ax.transAxes)
ax.text(1.0, 1.08, 'AA Index v4.0', fontsize=7.5, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='bottom', ha='right',
        transform=ax.transAxes)
# Small accent dot
ax.plot(0.0, 1.10, 'o', color=BLUE, markersize=4,
        transform=ax.transAxes, clip_on=False)

bh = 0.62
for v in [10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60]:
    ax.axvline(x=v, color=GRID, linewidth=0.4, zorder=0)

for i, m in enumerate(im):
    y = n - 1 - i
    sc = m['intel']
    a = 0.22 + 0.78 * (sc / 60)
    ax.barh(y, sc, height=bh, color=BLUE, alpha=a, zorder=2, edgecolor='none')
    if sc >= 53:
        ax.barh(y, sc, height=bh+0.12, color=BLUE, alpha=0.06, zorder=1, edgecolor='none')
    ax.text(sc + 0.7, y, str(sc), fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold',
            color=BLUE if sc >= 46 else TXT2, fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center')
    ax.text(-0.5, y, m['short'], fontsize=8.5, color=TXT,
            fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center', ha='right')

ax.text(64, -0.4, '24-pt gap from top to bottom', fontsize=7,
        color=BLUE, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top', ha='right', style='italic')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['speed']
sm = sorted([m for m in models if m['speed'] is not None], key=lambda m: m['speed'], reverse=True)
n = len(sm)
ax.set_xlim(0, 240); ax.set_ylim(-1.0, n + 1.5)

ax.text(0.0, 1.08, 'OUTPUT SPEED', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold',
        color=TEAL, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='bottom',
        transform=ax.transAxes)
ax.text(1.0, 1.08, 'tokens / sec', fontsize=7.5, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='bottom', ha='right',
        transform=ax.transAxes)
ax.plot(0.0, 1.10, 'o', color=TEAL, markersize=4,
        transform=ax.transAxes, clip_on=False)

for v in [50, 100, 150, 200]:
    ax.axvline(x=v, color=GRID, linewidth=0.4, zorder=0)

for i, m in enumerate(sm):
    y = n - 1 - i
    spd = m['speed']
    a = 0.22 + 0.78 * (spd / 220)
    ax.barh(y, spd, height=bh, color=TEAL, alpha=a, zorder=2, edgecolor='none')
    ax.text(spd+3, y, str(spd), fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold',
            color=TEAL if spd >= 100 else TXT2, fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center')
    ax.text(-2, y, m['short'], fontsize=8.5, color=TXT,
            fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center', ha='right')
    ax.text(spd+18, y, f'IQ {m["intel"]}', fontsize=5.5, color=TXT3,
            fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center')

ax.text(238, -0.4, 'Fastest model ranks last in intelligence', fontsize=7,
        color=TEAL, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top', ha='right', style='italic')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PRICING LANDSCAPE — log-scaled for visibility
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['price']
pm = sorted([m for m in models if m['price'] is not None], key=lambda m: m['price'])
n = len(pm)

# Use log scale for bar lengths so cheap models are still visible
log_max = np.log10(12)
ax.set_xlim(0, log_max * 1.05); ax.set_ylim(-1.0, n + 1.5)

ax.text(0.0, 1.08, 'PRICING LANDSCAPE', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold',
        color=AMBER, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='bottom',
        transform=ax.transAxes)
ax.text(1.0, 1.08, 'USD / 1M tokens (log scale)', fontsize=7.5, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='bottom', ha='right',
        transform=ax.transAxes)
ax.plot(0.0, 1.10, 'o', color=AMBER, markersize=4,
        transform=ax.transAxes, clip_on=False)

# Grid at actual price points
for pv in [0.3, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10]:
    ax.axvline(x=np.log10(pv), color=GRID, linewidth=0.4, zorder=0)
    ax.text(np.log10(pv), n + 0.8, f'${pv}' if pv >= 1 else f'${pv}',
            fontsize=5.5, color=TXT3, fontfamily='JetBrains Mono',
            ha='center', va='bottom')

for i, m in enumerate(pm):
    y = n - 1 - i
    pr = m['price']
    a = 0.22 + 0.78 * (pr / 10)
    bar_len = np.log10(pr) if pr > 0 else 0
    ax.barh(y, bar_len, height=bh, color=AMBER, alpha=a, zorder=2, edgecolor='none')
    lbl = f'${pr:.2f}' if pr < 1 else f'${pr:.1f}'
    ax.text(bar_len + 0.02, y, lbl, fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold',
            color=AMBER if pr >= 3 else TXT2, fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center')
    ax.text(-0.05, y, m['short'], fontsize=8.5, color=TXT,
            fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center', ha='right')

ax.text(log_max * 1.03, -0.4, '33x cost spread  |  Premium IQ != premium speed', fontsize=7,
        color=AMBER, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top', ha='right', style='italic')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TRADE-OFF BUBBLE CHART (HERO)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['trade']

ix0, ix1 = 28, 62
sy0, sy1 = 10, 230
ax.set_xlim(ix0, ix1); ax.set_ylim(sy0, sy1)

# Grid
for iv in range(30, 65, 5):
    ax.axvline(x=iv, color=GRID, linewidth=0.4, zorder=0)
for sv in [50, 100, 150, 200]:
    ax.axhline(y=sv, color=GRID, linewidth=0.4, zorder=0)

# Axis labels
ax.set_xlabel('INTELLIGENCE SCORE  >', fontsize=9, color=BLUE,
              fontfamily='Instrument Sans', labelpad=10)
ax.set_ylabel('OUTPUT SPEED (tokens/sec)  >', fontsize=9, color=TEAL,
              fontfamily='Instrument Sans', labelpad=10)

ax.set_xticks(range(30, 65, 5))
ax.set_xticklabels([str(x) for x in range(30, 65, 5)],
                    fontsize=7, color=TXT3, fontfamily='JetBrains Mono')
ax.set_yticks([50, 100, 150, 200])
ax.set_yticklabels(['50', '100', '150', '200'],
                    fontsize=7, color=TXT3, fontfamily='JetBrains Mono')
ax.tick_params(axis='both', length=2, color=TXT3, width=0.5)
for sp in ax.spines.values():
    sp.set_color(DIV); sp.set_linewidth(0.5)

# Header
ax.text(0.5, 1.12, 'THE INTELLIGENCE-SPEED-COST TRADE-OFF',
        fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', color=TXT,
        fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='bottom', ha='center',
        transform=ax.transAxes)
ax.text(0.5, 1.06, 'Bubble size = Price per 1M tokens  |  Larger = More expensive',
        fontsize=7.5, color=TXT3, fontfamily='Instrument Sans',
        va='bottom', ha='center', transform=ax.transAxes)

# Quadrant labels
ax.text(60, 222, 'HIGH IQ + HIGH SPEED', fontsize=6, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', ha='right', va='top', alpha=0.45)
ax.text(30, 16, 'LOW IQ + LOW SPEED', fontsize=6, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', ha='left', va='bottom', alpha=0.45)

# Diagonal ideal reference
ax.plot([ix0, ix1], [sy1 * 0.85, sy1 * 0.35], color=DIV,
        linewidth=0.7, linestyle=':', zorder=0, alpha=0.6)

# ── Bubbles ──
prices = [m['price'] for m in bubble_m]
pmin, pmax = min(prices), max(prices)

def p2s(p):
    t = (p - pmin) / (pmax - pmin) if pmax > pmin else 0.5
    return 60 + t * 1900

offsets = {
    'Gemini 3.1 Pro': ( 2.0,  14),
    'GPT-5.4':        ( 3.0, -15),
    'Opus 4.6':       (-3.5, -11),
    'Sonnet 4.6':     (-5.5,  13),
    'GLM-5.1':        (-5.0, -15),
    'Grok 4.20':      ( 2.5,  12),
    'Gemini 3 Flash': (-1.5, -16),
    'DeepSeek V3.2':  ( 3.0, -15),
    'Nemotron 3':     ( 3.0, -13),
    'gpt-oss-120B':   (-1.5,  14),
}

for m in bubble_m:

    s = p2s(m['price'])

    if m['price'] >= 5.0:
        col, ecol = BLUE, '#7CC4FF'
    elif m['price'] <= 1.0:
        col, ecol = AMBER, '#FFCA5C'
    else:
        col, ecol = TEAL, '#6EEECF'

    # Glow layers
    ax.scatter(x, y, s=s*3.2, color=col, alpha=0.04, edgecolors='none', zorder=1)
    ax.scatter(x, y, s=s*1.8, color=col, alpha=0.09, edgecolors='none', zorder=1)
    # Main
    ax.scatter(x, y, s=s, color=col, alpha=0.50, edgecolors=ecol,
               linewidth=1.0, zorder=3)

for m in bubble_m:
    x, y = m['intel'], m['speed']
    s = p2s(m['price'])
    ox, oy = offsets.get(m['short'], (0, 12))

    ax.annotate(m['short'],
                xy=(x, y), xytext=(x + ox, y + oy),
                fontsize=7, fontweight='bold', color=TXT,
                fontfamily='Instrument Sans', ha='center', va='center',
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color=TXT3, lw=0.4,
                                connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.15'),
                zorder=5)

    if s > 300:
        lbl = f'${m["price"]:.2f}' if m['price'] < 1 else f'${m["price"]:.1f}'
        ax.text(x, y, lbl, fontsize=5.5, color=WHITE,
                fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', ha='center', va='center',
                zorder=6, alpha=0.85)

# ── Insight callouts ──
ins = [
    (BLUE,  'BEST OVERALL',   'Gemini 3.1 Pro & GPT-5.4 tied at 57 AA Index'),
    (TEAL,  'BALANCED PICK',  'Gemini 3 Flash  |  IQ 46  |  149 tok/s  |  $1.10'),
    (AMBER, 'BEST VALUE',     'gpt-oss-120B  |  fastest + cheapest  |  but lowest IQ (33)'),
]
for idx, (col, title, desc) in enumerate(ins):
    iy = -5 - idx * 6.5
    ax.plot(ix0 + 0.3, iy, 's', color=col, markersize=4, zorder=5)
    ax.text(ix0 + 1.2, iy, title, fontsize=7, fontweight='bold',
            color=col, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center')
    ax.text(ix0 + 15, iy, desc, fontsize=6.5, color=TXT2,
            fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# METHODOLOGY
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['method']
ax.set_xlim(0, 100); ax.set_ylim(0, 100)
ax.plot([0, 100], [90, 90], color=DIV, linewidth=0.6)

ax.text(0, 75, 'ABOUT THE INDEX', fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold',

ax.text(0, 42,
        'The Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.0 aggregates performance across 10 independent evaluations: '
        'GDPval-AA, t2-Bench Telecom, Terminal-Bench Hard, SciCode, AA-LCR, AA-Omniscience, IFBench, '
        "Humanity's Last Exam, GPQA Diamond, and CritPt. "
        'All measurements conducted independently under standardized conditions.',
        fontsize=6, color=TXT3, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center', wrap=True)
ax.text(100, 12, 'artificialanalysis.ai', fontsize=6.5, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center', ha='right', alpha=0.6)
ax.text(100, 2, 'Data as of Index v4.0', fontsize=5.5, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center', ha='right', alpha=0.4)

# ─── Save ───
plt.savefig(OUTPUT_PATH, dpi=DPI, facecolor=BG, edgecolor='none', pad_inches=0.15)
plt.close()

img = Image.open(OUTPUT_PATH)
print(f"Saved: {OUTPUT_PATH}  |  {img.size[0]}x{img.size[1]} px")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Frontier AI Models Compared — Intelligence, Speed & Cost
A1 Portrait Poster (594x841mm, 150 DPI) — REFINED
Design Philosophy: Chromatic Data
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.font_manager as fm
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, Rectangle
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import os

FONT_DIR = "/usr/share/fonts/canvas-design"
OUTPUT_PATH = "/app/output/final_poster.png"

# Register fonts
for fn in ['InstrumentSans-Bold', 'InstrumentSans-Regular', 'InstrumentSans-Italic',
           'JetBrainsMono-Bold', 'JetBrainsMono-Regular',
           'Jura-Light', 'Jura-Medium', 'WorkSans-Bold', 'WorkSans-Regular']:
    fm.fontManager.addfont(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, f'{fn}.ttf'))

# ─── Palette ───
BG      = '#0C1017'
PANEL   = '#0F141D'
GRID    = '#131B27'
DIV     = '#1A2030'
TXT     = '#E2E8F0'
TXT2    = '#8896A8'
TXT3    = '#4A5568'
BLUE    = '#4DA8FF'
BLUE_D  = '#1A3A5C'
BLUE_BG = '#0C1A2E'
TEAL    = '#2DD4A8'
TEAL_D  = '#0F3D33'
TEAL_BG = '#0A1F1A'
AMBER   = '#F5A623'
AMBER_D = '#3D2E0A'
AMBER_BG= '#1A1508'
WHITE   = '#FFFFFF'

# ─── Data ───
models = [
    {'name': 'Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview', 'short': 'Gemini 3.1 Pro',  'intel': 57, 'speed': 129, 'price': 4.50},
    {'name': 'GPT-5.4 (xhigh)',        'short': 'GPT-5.4',         'intel': 57, 'speed': 72,  'price': 5.60},
    {'name': 'Claude Opus 4.6 (max)',   'short': 'Opus 4.6',       'intel': 53, 'speed': 40,  'price': 10.00},
    {'name': 'Muse Spark',              'short': 'Muse Spark',      'intel': 52, 'speed': None, 'price': None},
    {'name': 'Claude Sonnet 4.6 (max)', 'short': 'Sonnet 4.6',     'intel': 52, 'speed': 48,  'price': 6.00},
    {'name': 'GLM-5.1',                'short': 'GLM-5.1',         'intel': 51, 'speed': 40,  'price': 2.10},
    {'name': 'Grok 4.20 0309 v2',      'short': 'Grok 4.20',      'intel': 49, 'speed': 162, 'price': 3.00},
    {'name': 'Gemini 3 Flash',          'short': 'Gemini 3 Flash', 'intel': 46, 'speed': 149, 'price': 1.10},
    {'name': 'DeepSeek V3.2',          'short': 'DeepSeek V3.2',   'intel': 42, 'speed': 31,  'price': 0.30},
    {'name': 'NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super', 'short': 'Nemotron 3',     'intel': 36, 'speed': 193, 'price': 0.40},
    {'name': 'gpt-oss-120B (high)',     'short': 'gpt-oss-120B',   'intel': 33, 'speed': 206, 'price': 0.30},
]
bubble_m = [m for m in models if m['speed'] is not None and m['price'] is not None]

# ─── Figure ───
DPI = 150
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(23.39, 33.11), dpi=DPI, facecolor=BG)

ML, MR = 0.075, 0.055
CW = 1 - ML - MR

# Sections: (bottom, height) — bottom to top
sec = {
    'method': (0.010, 0.030),
    'trade':  (0.050, 0.260),
    'price':  (0.325, 0.158),
    'speed':  (0.498, 0.158),
    'intel':  (0.671, 0.170),
    'title':  (0.858, 0.132),
}

axes = {}
for name, (bot, ht) in sec.items():
    ax = fig.add_axes([ML, bot, CW, ht])
    ax.set_facecolor(BG)
    ax.set_xticks([]); ax.set_yticks([])
    for sp in ax.spines.values(): sp.set_visible(False)
    axes[name] = ax

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TITLE + HERO STATS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['title']
ax.set_xlim(0, 100); ax.set_ylim(0, 100)

# Title
ax.text(1, 95, 'FRONTIER AI MODELS COMPARED',
        fontsize=30, fontweight='bold', color=TXT,
        fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top')
ax.text(1, 82, 'Intelligence, Speed & Cost',
        fontsize=19, color=TXT2, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top')
ax.text(1, 71, 'Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.0  |  10 Models  |  3 Dimensions  |  10 Benchmarks',
        fontsize=9, color=TXT3, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top')

# Divider
ax.plot([0, 100], [65, 65], color=DIV, linewidth=1)

# Hero stat cards
cy, ch, cw = 32, 27, 29.5
cards = [
    {'x': 1.5, 'val': '57',  'acc': BLUE,  'dim': BLUE_D,  'bg': BLUE_BG,

    {'x': 66.5,'val': '33x', 'acc': AMBER, 'dim': AMBER_D, 'bg': AMBER_BG,
     'l1': 'PRICE RANGE FACTOR',     'l2': '$0.30 to $10.00 per 1M tokens'},
]
for c in cards:
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((c['x'], cy - ch/2), cw, ch,
                           boxstyle="round,pad=1.0", facecolor=c['bg'],
                           edgecolor=c['dim'], linewidth=1.0)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    ax.plot([c['x']+2, c['x']+9], [cy + ch/2 - 2]*2,
            color=c['acc'], linewidth=2.5, solid_capstyle='round')
    ax.text(c['x']+2, cy+4, c['val'], fontsize=38, fontweight='bold',
            color=c['acc'], fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center')
    ax.text(c['x']+2, cy-6.5, c['l1'], fontsize=7,
            color=TXT2, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center')
    ax.text(c['x']+2, cy-11, c['l2'], fontsize=6.5,
            color=TXT3, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# INTELLIGENCE RANKINGS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['intel']
im = sorted(models, key=lambda m: m['intel'], reverse=True)
n = len(im)
ax.set_xlim(0, 65); ax.set_ylim(-1.0, n + 1.5)

# Header
ax.text(0.0, 1.08, 'INTELLIGENCE RANKINGS', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold',
        color=BLUE, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='bottom',
        transform=ax.transAxes)
ax.text(1.0, 1.08, 'AA Index v4.0', fontsize=7.5, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='bottom', ha='right',
        transform=ax.transAxes)
# Small accent dot
ax.plot(0.0, 1.10, 'o', color=BLUE, markersize=4,
        transform=ax.transAxes, clip_on=False)

bh = 0.62
for v in [10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60]:
    ax.axvline(x=v, color=GRID, linewidth=0.4, zorder=0)

for i, m in enumerate(im):
    y = n - 1 - i
    sc = m['intel']
    a = 0.22 + 0.78 * (sc / 60)
    ax.barh(y, sc, height=bh, color=BLUE, alpha=a, zorder=2, edgecolor='none')
    if sc >= 53:
        ax.barh(y, sc, height=bh+0.12, color=BLUE, alpha=0.06, zorder=1, edgecolor='none')
    ax.text(sc + 0.7, y, str(sc), fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold',
            color=BLUE if sc >= 46 else TXT2, fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center')
    ax.text(-0.5, y, m['short'], fontsize=8.5, color=TXT,
            fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center', ha='right')

ax.text(64, -0.4, '24-pt gap from top to bottom', fontsize=7,
        color=BLUE, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top', ha='right', style='italic')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

ax = axes['speed']
sm = sorted([m for m in models if m['speed'] is not None], key=lambda m: m['speed'], reverse=True)
n = len(sm)
ax.set_xlim(0, 240); ax.set_ylim(-1.0, n + 1.5)

ax.text(0.0, 1.08, 'OUTPUT SPEED', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold',
        color=TEAL, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='bottom',
        transform=ax.transAxes)
ax.text(1.0, 1.08, 'tokens / sec', fontsize=7.5, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='bottom', ha='right',
        transform=ax.transAxes)
ax.plot(0.0, 1.10, 'o', color=TEAL, markersize=4,
        transform=ax.transAxes, clip_on=False)

for v in [50, 100, 150, 200]:
    ax.axvline(x=v, color=GRID, linewidth=0.4, zorder=0)

for i, m in enumerate(sm):
    y = n - 1 - i
    spd = m['speed']
    a = 0.22 + 0.78 * (spd / 220)
    ax.barh(y, spd, height=bh, color=TEAL, alpha=a, zorder=2, edgecolor='none')
    ax.text(spd+3, y, str(spd), fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold',
            color=TEAL if spd >= 100 else TXT2, fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center')
    ax.text(-2, y, m['short'], fontsize=8.5, color=TXT,
            fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center', ha='right')
    ax.text(spd+18, y, f'IQ {m["intel"]}', fontsize=5.5, color=TXT3,
            fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center')

ax.text(238, -0.4, 'Fastest model ranks last in intelligence', fontsize=7,
        color=TEAL, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top', ha='right', style='italic')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['price']
pm = sorted([m for m in models if m['price'] is not None], key=lambda m: m['price'])
n = len(pm)

# Use log scale for bar lengths so cheap models are still visible
log_max = np.log10(12)
ax.set_xlim(0, log_max * 1.05); ax.set_ylim(-1.0, n + 1.5)

ax.text(0.0, 1.08, 'PRICING LANDSCAPE', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold',
        color=AMBER, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='bottom',
        transform=ax.transAxes)
ax.text(1.0, 1.08, 'USD / 1M tokens (log scale)', fontsize=7.5, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='bottom', ha='right',
        transform=ax.transAxes)
ax.plot(0.0, 1.10, 'o', color=AMBER, markersize=4,
        transform=ax.transAxes, clip_on=False)

# Grid at actual price points
for pv in [0.3, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10]:
    ax.axvline(x=np.log10(pv), color=GRID, linewidth=0.4, zorder=0)
    ax.text(np.log10(pv), n + 0.8, f'${pv}' if pv >= 1 else f'${pv}',
            fontsize=5.5, color=TXT3, fontfamily='JetBrains Mono',
            ha='center', va='bottom')

for i, m in enumerate(pm):
    y = n - 1 - i
    pr = m['price']
    a = 0.22 + 0.78 * (pr / 10)
    bar_len = np.log10(pr) if pr > 0 else 0
    ax.barh(y, bar_len, height=bh, color=AMBER, alpha=a, zorder=2, edgecolor='none')
    lbl = f'${pr:.2f}' if pr < 1 else f'${pr:.1f}'
    ax.text(bar_len + 0.02, y, lbl, fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold',
            color=AMBER if pr >= 3 else TXT2, fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center')
    ax.text(-0.05, y, m['short'], fontsize=8.5, color=TXT,
            fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center', ha='right')

ax.text(log_max * 1.03, -0.4, '33x cost spread  |  Premium IQ != premium speed', fontsize=7,
        color=AMBER, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top', ha='right', style='italic')

ax = axes['trade']

ix0, ix1 = 28, 62
sy0, sy1 = 10, 230
ax.set_xlim(ix0, ix1); ax.set_ylim(sy0, sy1)

# Grid
for iv in range(30, 65, 5):
    ax.axvline(x=iv, color=GRID, linewidth=0.4, zorder=0)
for sv in [50, 100, 150, 200]:
    ax.axhline(y=sv, color=GRID, linewidth=0.4, zorder=0)

# Axis labels
ax.set_xlabel('INTELLIGENCE SCORE  >', fontsize=9, color=BLUE,
              fontfamily='Instrument Sans', labelpad=10)
ax.set_ylabel('OUTPUT SPEED (tokens/sec)  >', fontsize=9, color=TEAL,
              fontfamily='Instrument Sans', labelpad=10)

ax.set_xticks(range(30, 65, 5))
ax.set_xticklabels([str(x) for x in range(30, 65, 5)],
                    fontsize=7, color=TXT3, fontfamily='JetBrains Mono')
ax.set_yticks([50, 100, 150, 200])
ax.set_yticklabels(['50', '100', '150', '200'],
                    fontsize=7, color=TXT3, fontfamily='JetBrains Mono')
ax.tick_params(axis='both', length=2, color=TXT3, width=0.5)
for sp in ax.spines.values():
    sp.set_color(DIV); sp.set_linewidth(0.5)

ax.text(0.5, 1.12, 'THE INTELLIGENCE-SPEED-COST TRADE-OFF',

ax.text(30, 16, 'LOW IQ + LOW SPEED', fontsize=6, color=TXT3,

    return 60 + t * 1900

offsets = {

    'DeepSeek V3.2':  ( 3.0, -15),
    'Nemotron 3':     ( 3.0, -13),
    'gpt-oss-120B':   (-1.5,  14),
}

    ax.scatter(x, y, s=s*1.8, color=col, alpha=0.09, edgecolors='none', zorder=1)

for m in bubble_m:

    ox, oy = offsets.get(m['short'], (0, 12))

    ax.annotate(m['short'],

                fontsize=7, fontweight='bold', color=TXT,

    if s > 300:

        ax.text(x, y, lbl, fontsize=5.5, color=WHITE,

# ── Insight callouts ──
ins = [

]
for idx, (col, title, desc) in enumerate(ins):
    iy = -5 - idx * 6.5
    ax.plot(ix0 + 0.3, iy, 's', color=col, markersize=4, zorder=5)
    ax.text(ix0 + 1.2, iy, title, fontsize=7, fontweight='bold',

    ax.text(ix0 + 15, iy, desc, fontsize=6.5, color=TXT2,
            fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

ax = axes['method']
ax.set_xlim(0, 100); ax.set_ylim(0, 100)
ax.plot([0, 100], [90, 90], color=DIV, linewidth=0.6)

ax.text(0, 75, 'ABOUT THE INDEX', fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold',

ax.text(0, 42,

ax.text(100, 2, 'Data as of Index v4.0', fontsize=5.5, color=TXT3,

# ─── Save ───
plt.savefig(OUTPUT_PATH, dpi=DPI, facecolor=BG, edgecolor='none', pad_inches=0.15)
plt.close()

img = Image.open(OUTPUT_PATH)
print(f"Saved: {OUTPUT_PATH}  |  {img.size[0]}x{img.size[1]} px")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Frontier AI Models Compared — Intelligence, Speed & Cost
A1 Portrait Poster (594x841mm, 150 DPI) — REFINED
Design Philosophy: Chromatic Data
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.font_manager as fm
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, Rectangle
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import os

FONT_DIR = "/usr/share/fonts/canvas-design"
OUTPUT_PATH = "/app/output/final_poster.png"

# Register fonts
for fn in ['InstrumentSans-Bold', 'InstrumentSans-Regular', 'InstrumentSans-Italic',
           'JetBrainsMono-Bold', 'JetBrainsMono-Regular',
           'Jura-Light', 'Jura-Medium', 'WorkSans-Bold', 'WorkSans-Regular']:
    fm.fontManager.addfont(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, f'{fn}.ttf'))

# ─── Palette ───
BG      = '#0C1017'
PANEL   = '#0F141D'
GRID    = '#131B27'
DIV     = '#1A2030'
TXT     = '#E2E8F0'
TXT2    = '#8896A8'
TXT3    = '#4A5568'
BLUE    = '#4DA8FF'
BLUE_D  = '#1A3A5C'
BLUE_BG = '#0C1A2E'
TEAL    = '#2DD4A8'
TEAL_D  = '#0F3D33'
TEAL_BG = '#0A1F1A'
AMBER   = '#F5A623'
AMBER_D = '#3D2E0A'
AMBER_BG= '#1A1508'
WHITE   = '#FFFFFF'

# ─── Data ───
models = [
    {'name': 'Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview', 'short': 'Gemini 3.1 Pro',  'intel': 57, 'speed': 129, 'price': 4.50},
    {'name': 'GPT-5.4 (xhigh)',        'short': 'GPT-5.4',         'intel': 57, 'speed': 72,  'price': 5.60},
    {'name': 'Claude Opus 4.6 (max)',   'short': 'Opus 4.6',       'intel': 53, 'speed': 40,  'price': 10.00},
    {'name': 'Muse Spark',              'short': 'Muse Spark',      'intel': 52, 'speed': None, 'price': None},
    {'name': 'Claude Sonnet 4.6 (max)', 'short': 'Sonnet 4.6',     'intel': 52, 'speed': 48,  'price': 6.00},
    {'name': 'GLM-5.1',                'short': 'GLM-5.1',         'intel': 51, 'speed': 40,  'price': 2.10},
    {'name': 'Grok 4.20 0309 v2',      'short': 'Grok 4.20',      'intel': 49, 'speed': 162, 'price': 3.00},
    {'name': 'Gemini 3 Flash',          'short': 'Gemini 3 Flash', 'intel': 46, 'speed': 149, 'price': 1.10},
    {'name': 'DeepSeek V3.2',          'short': 'DeepSeek V3.2',   'intel': 42, 'speed': 31,  'price': 0.30},
    {'name': 'NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super', 'short': 'Nemotron 3',     'intel': 36, 'speed': 193, 'price': 0.40},
    {'name': 'gpt-oss-120B (high)',     'short': 'gpt-oss-120B',   'intel': 33, 'speed': 206, 'price': 0.30},
]
bubble_m = [m for m in models if m['speed'] is not None and m['price'] is not None]

# ─── Figure ───
DPI = 150
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(23.39, 33.11), dpi=DPI, facecolor=BG)

ML, MR = 0.075, 0.055
CW = 1 - ML - MR

# Sections: (bottom, height) — bottom to top
sec = {
    'method': (0.010, 0.030),
    'trade':  (0.050, 0.260),
    'price':  (0.325, 0.158),
    'speed':  (0.498, 0.158),
    'intel':  (0.671, 0.170),
    'title':  (0.858, 0.132),
}

axes = {}
for name, (bot, ht) in sec.items():

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Frontier AI Models Compared — Intelligence, Speed & Cost
A1 Portrait Poster (594x841mm, 150 DPI) — FINAL REFINED
Design Philosophy: Chromatic Data
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.font_manager as fm
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter
import os

FONT_DIR = "/usr/share/fonts/canvas-design"
OUTPUT_PATH = "/app/output/final_poster.png"

for fn in ['InstrumentSans-Bold','InstrumentSans-Regular','InstrumentSans-Italic',
           'JetBrainsMono-Bold','JetBrainsMono-Regular',
           'Jura-Light','Jura-Medium','WorkSans-Bold','WorkSans-Regular']:
    fm.fontManager.addfont(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, f'{fn}.ttf'))

# ─── Palette ───
BG     = '#0B0F15'
PANEL  = '#0E1319'
GRID   = '#121922'
DIV    = '#182030'
TXT    = '#E2E8F0'
TXT2   = '#8896A8'
TXT3   = '#4A5568'
BLUE   = '#4DA8FF'
BLUE_D = '#1A3A5C'
BLUE_G = '#0C1A2E'
TEAL   = '#2DD4A8'
TEAL_D = '#0F3D33'
TEAL_G = '#0A1F1A'
AMBER  = '#F5A623'
AMBER_D= '#3D2E0A'
AMBER_G= '#1A1508'
WHITE  = '#FFFFFF'

# ─── Data ───
models = [
    {'short': 'Gemini 3.1 Pro',  'intel': 57, 'speed': 129, 'price': 4.50},
    {'short': 'GPT-5.4',         'intel': 57, 'speed': 72,  'price': 5.60},
    {'short': 'Opus 4.6',       'intel': 53, 'speed': 40,  'price': 10.00},
    {'short': 'Muse Spark',      'intel': 52, 'speed': None, 'price': None},
    {'short': 'Sonnet 4.6',     'intel': 52, 'speed': 48,  'price': 6.00},
    {'short': 'GLM-5.1',        'intel': 51, 'speed': 40,  'price': 2.10},
    {'short': 'Grok 4.20',      'intel': 49, 'speed': 162, 'price': 3.00},
    {'short': 'Gemini 3 Flash', 'intel': 46, 'speed': 149, 'price': 1.10},
    {'short': 'DeepSeek V3.2',  'intel': 42, 'speed': 31,  'price': 0.30},
    {'short': 'Nemotron 3',     'intel': 36, 'speed': 193, 'price': 0.40},
    {'short': 'gpt-oss-120B',   'intel': 33, 'speed': 206, 'price': 0.30},
]
bub = [m for m in models if m['speed'] is not None and m['price'] is not None]

# ─── Figure ───
DPI = 150
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(23.39, 33.11), dpi=DPI, facecolor=BG)

ML, MR = 0.072, 0.052
CW = 1 - ML - MR

# Layout: bottom to top
sec = {
    'method': (0.008, 0.028),
    'trade':  (0.044, 0.270),
    'price':  (0.328, 0.155),
    'speed':  (0.498, 0.155),
    'intel':  (0.668, 0.170),
    'title':  (0.853, 0.140),
}

axes = {}
for name, (bot, ht) in sec.items():
    ax = fig.add_axes([ML, bot, CW, ht])
    ax.set_facecolor(BG)
    ax.set_xticks([]); ax.set_yticks([])
    for sp in ax.spines.values(): sp.set_visible(False)
    axes[name] = ax

BH = 0.62  # bar height

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TITLE + HERO STATS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['title']
ax.set_xlim(0, 100); ax.set_ylim(0, 100)

# Title block
ax.text(1, 96, 'FRONTIER AI MODELS COMPARED',
        fontsize=32, fontweight='bold', color=TXT,
        fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top')
ax.text(1, 84, 'Intelligence, Speed & Cost',
        fontsize=20, color=TXT2, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top')
ax.text(1, 73, 'Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.0  |  10 Models  |  3 Dimensions  |  10 Benchmarks',
        fontsize=9, color=TXT3, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top')

# Accent line under subtitle
ax.plot([1, 35], [70, 70], color=BLUE, linewidth=1.5, solid_capstyle='round', alpha=0.6)
ax.plot([35, 60], [70, 70], color=TEAL, linewidth=1.5, solid_capstyle='round', alpha=0.6)
ax.plot([60, 99], [70, 70], color=AMBER, linewidth=1.5, solid_capstyle='round', alpha=0.6)

# Hero stat cards
cy, ch, cw = 40, 32, 30.5
cards = [
    {'x': 1.2, 'val': '57',  'acc': BLUE,  'dim': BLUE_D,  'bg': BLUE_G,
     'l1': 'TIED TOP INTELLIGENCE', 'l2': 'Gemini 3.1 Pro & GPT-5.4', 'unit': 'AA Index'},
    {'x': 34.2,'val': '206', 'acc': TEAL,  'dim': TEAL_D,  'bg': TEAL_G,
     'l1': 'FASTEST OUTPUT SPEED',   'l2': 'gpt-oss-120B', 'unit': 'tokens/sec'},
    {'x': 67.2,'val': '33x', 'acc': AMBER, 'dim': AMBER_D, 'bg': AMBER_G,
     'l1': 'PRICE RANGE FACTOR',     'l2': '$0.30 to $10.00', 'unit': 'per 1M tokens'},
]
for c in cards:
    # Card
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((c['x'], cy - ch/2), cw, ch,
                           boxstyle="round,pad=1.2", facecolor=c['bg'],
                           edgecolor=c['dim'], linewidth=1.0)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    # Top accent bar
    ax.plot([c['x']+2.5, c['x']+10], [cy + ch/2 - 2.5]*2,
            color=c['acc'], linewidth=3, solid_capstyle='round')
    # Value
    ax.text(c['x']+2.5, cy+4, c['val'], fontsize=42, fontweight='bold',
            color=c['acc'], fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center')
    # Unit
    ax.text(c['x']+2.5, cy-5, c['unit'], fontsize=6, color=TXT3,
            fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center')
    # Labels
    ax.text(c['x']+2.5, cy-9.5, c['l1'], fontsize=7.5,
            color=TXT2, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center')
    ax.text(c['x']+2.5, cy-13.5, c['l2'], fontsize=7,
            color=TXT3, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# INTELLIGENCE RANKINGS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['intel']
im = sorted(models, key=lambda m: m['intel'], reverse=True)
n = len(im)
ax.set_xlim(0, 65); ax.set_ylim(-1.2, n + 2.0)

# Section header with accent line
ax.plot([0, 0.22], [1.10, 1.10], color=BLUE, linewidth=3, solid_capstyle='butt',
        transform=ax.transAxes, clip_on=False)
ax.text(0.0, 1.14, '  INTELLIGENCE RANKINGS', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold',
        color=BLUE, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='bottom',
        transform=ax.transAxes)
ax.text(1.0, 1.08, 'AA Index v4.0', fontsize=7.5, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='bottom', ha='right',
        transform=ax.transAxes)

for v in [10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60]:
    ax.axvline(x=v, color=GRID, linewidth=0.4, zorder=0)

for i, m in enumerate(im):
    y = n - 1 - i
    sc = m['intel']
    a = 0.20 + 0.80 * (sc / 60)
    ax.barh(y, sc, height=BH, color=BLUE, alpha=a, zorder=2, edgecolor='none')
    if sc >= 53:
        ax.barh(y, sc, height=BH+0.15, color=BLUE, alpha=0.05, zorder=1, edgecolor='none')
    # Score
    ax.text(sc + 0.7, y, str(sc), fontsize=10, fontweight='bold',
            color=BLUE if sc >= 46 else TXT2, fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center')
    # Name
    ax.text(-0.5, y, m['short'], fontsize=9, color=TXT,
            fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center', ha='right')
    # Thin horizontal guide
    ax.axhline(y=y, color=GRID, linewidth=0.2, zorder=0, xmin=0, xmax=0.05)

# Bottom insight
ax.text(64, -0.6, '24-pt gap from top to bottom', fontsize=7,
        color=BLUE, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top', ha='right', style='italic')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# OUTPUT SPEED
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['speed']
sm = sorted([m for m in models if m['speed'] is not None], key=lambda m: m['speed'], reverse=True)
n = len(sm)
ax.set_xlim(0, 240); ax.set_ylim(-1.2, n + 2.0)

ax.plot([0, 0.22], [1.10, 1.10], color=TEAL, linewidth=3, solid_capstyle='butt',
        transform=ax.transAxes, clip_on=False)
ax.text(0.0, 1.14, '  OUTPUT SPEED', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold',
        color=TEAL, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='bottom',
        transform=ax.transAxes)
ax.text(1.0, 1.08, 'tokens / sec', fontsize=7.5, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='bottom', ha='right',
        transform=ax.transAxes)

for v in [50, 100, 150, 200]:
    ax.axvline(x=v, color=GRID, linewidth=0.4, zorder=0)

for i, m in enumerate(sm):
    y = n - 1 - i
    spd = m['speed']
    a = 0.20 + 0.80 * (spd / 220)
    ax.barh(y, spd, height=BH, color=TEAL, alpha=a, zorder=2, edgecolor='none')
    ax.text(spd+3, y, str(spd), fontsize=10, fontweight='bold',
            color=TEAL if spd >= 100 else TXT2, fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center')
    ax.text(-2, y, m['short'], fontsize=9, color=TXT,
            fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center', ha='right')
    # IQ annotation
    ax.text(spd+18, y, f'IQ {m["intel"]}', fontsize=5.5, color=TXT3,
            fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center')
    ax.axhline(y=y, color=GRID, linewidth=0.2, zorder=0, xmin=0, xmax=0.03)

# Highlight callout
ax.text(238, -0.6, 'Fastest model ranks last in intelligence', fontsize=7,
        color=TEAL, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top', ha='right', style='italic')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PRICING LANDSCAPE (log scale)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['price']
pm = sorted([m for m in models if m['price'] is not None], key=lambda m: m['price'])
n = len(pm)
log_max = np.log10(12) * 1.05
ax.set_xlim(0, log_max); ax.set_ylim(-1.2, n + 2.0)

ax.plot([0, 0.22], [1.10, 1.10], color=AMBER, linewidth=3, solid_capstyle='butt',
        transform=ax.transAxes, clip_on=False)
ax.text(0.0, 1.14, '  PRICING LANDSCAPE', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold',
        color=AMBER, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='bottom',
        transform=ax.transAxes)
ax.text(1.0, 1.08, 'USD / 1M tokens (log scale)', fontsize=7.5, color=TXT3,
        fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='bottom', ha='right',
        transform=ax.transAxes)

# Grid at price points
for pv in [0.3, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10]:
    ax.axvline(x=np.log10(pv), color=GRID, linewidth=0.4, zorder=0)
    ax.text(np.log10(pv), n + 0.9, f'${pv}' if pv >= 1 else f'${pv}',
            fontsize=5.5, color=TXT3, fontfamily='JetBrains Mono',
            ha='center', va='bottom')

for i, m in enumerate(pm):
    y = n - 1 - i
    pr = m['price']
    a = 0.20 + 0.80 * (pr / 10)
    bl = np.log10(pr) if pr > 0 else 0
    ax.barh(y, bl, height=BH, color=AMBER, alpha=a, zorder=2, edgecolor='none')
    lbl = f'${pr:.2f}' if pr < 1 else f'${pr:.1f}'
    ax.text(bl + 0.02, y, lbl, fontsize=10, fontweight='bold',
            color=AMBER if pr >= 3 else TXT2, fontfamily='JetBrains Mono', va='center')
    ax.text(-0.05, y, m['short'], fontsize=9, color=TXT,
            fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='center', ha='right')
    ax.axhline(y=y, color=GRID, linewidth=0.2, zorder=0, xmin=0, xmax=0.03)

ax.text(log_max * 0.97, -0.6, '33x cost spread  |  Premium IQ != premium speed', fontsize=7,
        color=AMBER, fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='top', ha='right', style='italic')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TRADE-OFF BUBBLE CHART (HERO)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes['trade']

ix0, ix1 = 28, 62
sy0, sy1 = 10, 230
ax.set_xlim(ix0, ix1); ax.set_ylim(sy0, sy1)

# Grid
for iv in range(30, 65, 5):
    ax.axvline(x=iv, color=GRID, linewidth=0.35, zorder=0)
for sv in [50, 100, 150, 200]:
    ax.axhline(y=sv, color=GRID, linewidth=0.35, zorder=0)

ax.set_xlabel('INTELLIGENCE SCORE  >', fontsize=9.5, color=BLUE,
              fontfamily='Instrument Sans', labelpad=10)
ax.set_ylabel('OUTPUT SPEED (tokens/sec)  >', fontsize=9.5, color=TEAL,
              fontfamily='Instrument Sans', labelpad=10)

ax.set_xticks(range(30, 65, 5))
ax.set_xticklabels([str(x) for x in range(30, 65, 5)],
                    fontsize=7.5, color=TXT3, fontfamily='JetBrains Mono')
ax.set_yticks([50, 100, 150, 200])
ax.set_yticklabels(['50', '100', '150', '200'],
                    fontsize=7.5, color=TXT3, fontfamily='JetBrains Mono')
ax.tick_params(axis='both', length=2, color=TXT3, width=0.5)
for sp in ax.spines.values():
    sp.set_color(DIV); sp.set_linewidth(0.5)

# Section header
ax.text(0.5, 1.14, 'THE INTELLIGENCE-SPEED-COST TRADE-OFF',
        fontsize=17, fontweight='bold', color=TXT,
        fontfamily='Instrument Sans', va='bottom', ha='center',
        transform=ax.transAxes)
